name: Home and Living
shortDescription: Tailored home and living support that helps people with disability live more independently and participate in their community.
plainEnglishSummary: If you have a disability and need help with everyday life at home, this service may support you with personal care, cooking, cleaning, community activities and developing independent living skills.
audience: People with disability who need support with everyday living
People who want to live alone or share support with housemates
People requiring medium-term accommodation while transitioning to a long-term home
People funded through the NDIS, DSOA, My Aged Care or Lifetime Support Scheme
availabilityNote: Support can be available 24 hours a day and is tailored to the person's needs and available funding. Service availability and accommodation options depend on location, support requirements, vacancies and funding arrangements. Clients remain responsible for ordinary living expenses such as groceries, utilities and white goods.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility, funding or accommodation availability. DHS Disability Services can provide support through funding arrangements including the NDIS, Disability Support for Older Australians, My Aged Care and the Lifetime Support Scheme. Contact the provider to discuss support needs, location, funding and available options.
